papers.title: Covalently functionalized poly(etheretherketone) implants with osteogenic growth peptide (OGP) to improve osteogenesis activity.
papers.abstract: Polyetheretherketone (PEEK), as the most promising implant material for orthopedics and dental applications, has bone-like stiffness, excellent fatigue resistance, X-ray transparency, and near absence of immune toxicity. However, due to biological inertness, its bone conduction and bone ingrowth performance is limited. The surface modification of PEEK is an option to overcome these shortcomings and retain most of its favorable properties, especially when excellent osseointegration is desired. In this study, a simple reaction procedure was employed to bind the osteogenic growth peptide (OGP) on the surface of PEEK materials by covalent chemical grafting to construct a bioactive interface. The PEEK surface was activated by N,N'-disuccinimidyl carbonate (DSC) after hydroxylation, and then OGP was covalently grafted with amino groups. The functionalized surface of PEEK samples were characterized by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), water contact angle measurement and biological evaluation in vitro. OGP-functionalized PEEK surface significantly promoted the attachment, proliferation, alkaline phosphatase (ALP) activity and mineralization of pre-osteoblast cells (MC3T3-E1). The in vivo rat tibia implantation model is adopted and micro-CT analyses demonstrated that the OGP coating significantly promoted new bone formation around the samples. The in vitro and in vivo results reveal that the modification by covalent chemical functionalization with OGP on PEEK surface can augment new bone formation surrounding implants compared to bare PEEK and PEEK implant modified by covalently attached OGP is promising in orthopedic and dental applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及PEEK表面改性促进骨整合，但未涉及增材制造、多孔结构、应力遮挡或力学测试。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no porous structure, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stiffness matching or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PEEK植入物的骨整合能力。
summary_zh.method: 通过化学接枝将骨生长肽(OGP)共价固定在PEEK表面。
summary_zh.result: OGP修饰显著促进成骨细胞附着、增殖、ALP活性和矿化，体内实验显示新骨形成增加。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和体内大鼠胫骨植入模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the osseointegration of PEEK implants by overcoming their biological inertness.
summary_en.method: Osteogenic growth peptide (OGP) was covalently grafted onto hydroxylated PEEK surfaces via N,N'-disuccinimidyl carbonate activation.
summary_en.result: OGP-functionalized PEEK significantly promoted pre-osteoblast attachment, proliferation, ALP activity, and mineralization in vitro, and increased new bone formation in a rat tibia implantation model.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and in vivo rat tibia implantation with micro-CT analysis.
